note: Plans Claude made for the asks in layers-plan.cases.ts, replayed in every run by layers-plan.recorded.test.ts.

plans.request: Put the laptop B-roll in a small box in the top right corner from "new" to "fast", fading in.
plans.reply: I put the laptop clip in a small box in the top right corner, muted, from "new" to "fast", with a 0.4-second fade-in. I placed it for a 1920x1080 frame, so if the corner looks off you can drag the box into place.

plans.request: Add a big yellow title that says ALL DAY over the last two words, flying in from below.
plans.reply: I added a big yellow title that says ALL DAY. It rises in from below on "all day" at the end of the battery line and stays up for just under a second after.

plans.request: Trim the start so the video begins on the word "show".
plans.reply: I trimmed the start, so the video now opens on "show you the new laptop I have been using". Nothing else in the cut changed.

plans.request: Lay a black layer at 40% over the whole video so text stands out, then put the laptop B-roll over the first sentence with its sound off.
plans.reply: I put the laptop typing footage over the opening sentence, up to "the new laptop I have been using", with its own sound off so you hear only your voice. A black layer at 40% now covers the whole video, from the first frame to the last, so the text stands out.
